intro.en: Comparing amounts and equality: more books than, as many hours as, as hot as, more than a hundred, the same as.

tan.en: as (before an adjective or adverb, in tan…como)

tantas horas como.nota: Tanto agrees with the noun: tanto, tanta, tantos, tantas.

el mismo.nota: It agrees: la misma, los mismos, las mismas.

texto.en:
With **nouns**: **más** / **menos** + noun + **que**: tengo **más** libros **que** tú.

As much, as many: **tanto, tanta, tantos, tantas** + noun + **como**. It agrees with the noun: **tantas** horas **como** tú.

With **adjectives or adverbs**: **tan + adjective/adverb + como**: el café está **tan caliente como** el té. **Tan** does not change; the adjective agrees with the noun when its form allows it.

With **verbs**: trabaja **más que** yo; gana **menos que** yo; no gasto **tanto como** tú. Here **tanto** does not agree with a noun.

Before a **number**, than is **de**, not que: **más de** cien euros, **menos de** mil.

For the same person or thing: **el mismo** horario **que** tú; **tengo la misma profesora que** tú.

Also: **igual que**, **diferente de**, **parecido a**, **el doble**, **la mitad**. Pronunciation varies: c before i may sound like s (seseo) or like the th in think (distinción).

filas: El café está tan caliente como el té.
verb + más / menos que, tanto como

frases.en: Do you work as many hours as your brother?

frases.es: No, él trabaja más que yo, pero gana menos.
frases.en: No, he works more than me, but he earns less.

frases.es: Menos de mil euros. Yo gano el doble que él.
frases.en: Less than a thousand euros. I earn twice as much as he does.
analisis: twice as much as he does

frases.es: Yo tengo el mismo horario que tú, pero no gasto tanto como tú.
frases.en: I have the same hours as you, but I don't spend as much as you.

frases.es: Es que mi piso cuesta más de ochocientos euros al mes.
frases.en: The thing is, my flat costs more than eight hundred euros a month.
analisis: más de ochocientos euros al mes

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (60–80 words).** Write comparisons of equality about you and a friend: Trabajo tanto como…, tengo tantos… como…

**Speak (about 1 minute).** Compare aloud life now and life ten years ago using tan… como and tanto… como.
